metadata.description: ARM template to deploy AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs Analytic Rules to Microsoft Sentinel
metadata.author: AAD Threat Hunting Rule Pack

metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace that Sentinel is deployed on
Toggle to deploy all analytic rules in disabled state for staged rollout.
savedSearches function alias used by rules.

properties.displayName: Network Allowlist (Trusted IP / CIDR / Ranges)
properties.description: Trusted internal IPs/CIDRs/ranges excluded from AADNonInteractive rules to suppress noise from sanctioned sources.

properties.displayName: [parameters('functionAlias')]
properties.query:
let _allow = materialize(union isfuzzy=true (print R="" | take 0), (_GetWatchlist('NetworkAllowlist') | project R = tostring(IPOrRange)) | where isnotempty(R));
let _allowCIDR  = toscalar(_allow | where not(R matches regex @'^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+-\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') | extend R = iff(R has '/', R, strcat(R, '/32')) | summarize make_list(R));
let _allowRange = toscalar(_allow | where R matches regex @'^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+-\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$' | summarize make_list(R));
T
| extend _ip = tostring(IPAddress)
| where isempty(_ip) or array_length(_allowCIDR) == 0 or isnull(ipv4_is_in_any_range(_ip, _allowCIDR)) or not(ipv4_is_in_any_range(_ip, _allowCIDR))
| mv-apply _r = _allowRange to typeof(string) on (
    extend _lo = tostring(split(_r,'-')[0]), _hi = tostring(split(_r,'-')[1])
    | extend _inRange = isnotempty(_ip) and ipv4_compare(_ip, _lo) >= 0 and ipv4_compare(_ip, _hi) <= 0
    | summarize _anyInRange = max(toint(_inRange)))
| where isnull(_anyInRange) or _anyInRange == 0
| project-away _ip, _anyInRange

properties.displayName: Hunt: NI Sign-Ins from New/Unseen Countries (Baseline Deviation)
properties.query:
let LookbackWindow = 30d;
let RecentWindow   = 7d;
let Baseline =
    AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(LookbackWindow) .. ago(RecentWindow))
    | where ResultType == 0
    | summarize HistoricCountries = make_set(Location) by UserPrincipalName;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(RecentWindow)
| where ResultType == 0
| where isnotempty(Location)
| join kind=leftouter Baseline on UserPrincipalName
| where isempty(HistoricCountries) or not(HistoricCountries has Location)
| summarize
    Count        = count(),
    NewCountries = make_set(Location),
    IPs          = make_set(IPAddress),
    Apps         = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    FirstSeen    = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen     = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by Count desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Identifies users with non-interactive sign-ins from countries not present in their 30-day baseline. High-confidence hunter for token theft replayed from new attacker infrastructure. Adjust LookbackWindow and RecentWindow as needed.

properties.displayName: Hunt: Dormant Accounts with Sudden Non-Interactive Token Activity
properties.query:
let DormantThreshold = 45d;
let RecentWindow     = 7d;
let ActiveUsers =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(DormantThreshold) .. ago(RecentWindow))
    | where ResultType == 0
    | summarize by UserPrincipalName;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(RecentWindow)
| where ResultType == 0
| join kind=leftanti ActiveUsers on UserPrincipalName
| summarize
    NICount   = count(),
    Countries = make_set(Location),
    IPs       = make_set(IPAddress),
    Apps      = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName
| where NICount > 3
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by NICount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Finds accounts that had no interactive sign-in for 45+ days but are suddenly producing non-interactive token refreshes. Common indicator of a forgotten/stale account being exploited via a pre-existing stolen refresh token.

properties.displayName: Hunt: Non-Interactive Token Refresh Frequency Spike (5x Baseline)
properties.query:
let BaselineDays = 14;
let RecentWindow = 1d;
let Baseline =
    AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(totimespan(strcat(tostring(BaselineDays), 'd'))) .. ago(RecentWindow))
    | where ResultType == 0
    | summarize BaselineTotal = count() by UserPrincipalName
    | extend AvgPerDay = todouble(BaselineTotal) / todouble(BaselineDays - 1);
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(RecentWindow)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize
    TodayCount = count(),
    Countries  = make_set(Location),
    IPs        = make_set(IPAddress),
    Apps       = make_set(AppDisplayName)
  by UserPrincipalName
| join kind=leftouter Baseline on UserPrincipalName
| extend AvgPerDay   = iff(isempty(AvgPerDay), 0.0, AvgPerDay)
| extend SpikeFactor = iff(AvgPerDay > 0, todouble(TodayCount) / AvgPerDay, todouble(TodayCount))
| where SpikeFactor > 5 and TodayCount > 20
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| project UserPrincipalName, TodayCount, AvgPerDay, SpikeFactor, Countries, IPs, Apps
| order by SpikeFactor desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Detects users whose non-interactive token refresh volume today is 5x or more above their 14-day average, requiring at least 20 refreshes today. Attacker automation typically generates far more token refreshes than legitimate client activity.

properties.displayName: Hunt: NI Auth to Sensitive/Admin Apps Outside Business Hours
properties.query:
let SensitiveApps = dynamic([
    "Microsoft Azure Management", "Azure Portal",
    "Microsoft Graph", "Office 365 Exchange Online",
    "Microsoft Teams", "Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance Center",
    "Azure Active Directory", "Microsoft 365 Defender",
    "Microsoft 365 Admin", "SharePoint Online Web Client Extensibility"
]);
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResultType == 0
| where AppDisplayName in~ (SensitiveApps)
| extend HourUTC = hourofday(TimeGenerated)
| where HourUTC < 6 or HourUTC > 22
| summarize
    Count     = count(),
    Hours     = make_set(HourUTC),
    IPs       = make_set(IPAddress),
    Countries = make_set(Location),
    Apps      = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by Count desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Hunts for non-interactive sign-ins to admin/sensitive Microsoft 365 and Azure applications that occur outside typical business hours (before 06:00 or after 22:00 UTC). Adjust the sensitive app list and hour thresholds to match your environment.

properties.displayName: Hunt: Interactive-to-NI Token Pivot (IP Change, Any Country)
properties.query:
// Broader version of the analytic rule: catches IP change without requiring country change
let TimeWindow = 4h;
let InteractiveSessions =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(TimeWindow)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | project
        UserPrincipalName,
        InteractiveTime    = TimeGenerated,
        InteractiveIP      = IPAddress,
        InteractiveCountry = Location,
        AuthRequirement    = AuthenticationRequirement,
        CAStatus           = ConditionalAccessStatus;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(TimeWindow)
| where ResultType == 0
| join kind=inner InteractiveSessions on UserPrincipalName
| where IPAddress != InteractiveIP
   and  (TimeGenerated - InteractiveTime) between (0m .. TimeWindow)
| extend InteractiveIPClass = strcat(split(InteractiveIP, ".")[0], ".", split(InteractiveIP, ".")[1])
| extend NIIPClass           = strcat(split(IPAddress, ".")[0], ".", split(IPAddress, ".")[1])
| where InteractiveIPClass != NIIPClass
| project
    NITime             = TimeGenerated,
    InteractiveTime,
    UserPrincipalName,
    AppDisplayName,
    NIIPAddress        = IPAddress,
    NICountry          = Location,
    InteractiveIP,
    InteractiveCountry,
    AuthRequirement,
    CAStatus,
    TimeDelta          = (TimeGenerated - InteractiveTime)
| order by UserPrincipalName asc, InteractiveTime asc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Broader interactive-to-NI pivot hunt: NI IP /16 differs from interactive session IP. No country change required. Catches VPN split-tunnel abuse and same-country attacker infrastructure.

properties.displayName: Hunt: NI Token Used Across Many Apps or IPs Simultaneously
properties.query:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize
    AppCount     = dcount(AppDisplayName),
    Apps         = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    IPCount      = dcount(IPAddress),
    IPs          = make_set(IPAddress),
    Countries    = make_set(Location),
    RefreshCount = count(),
    FirstSeen    = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen     = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName, UniqueTokenIdentifier
| where AppCount > 4 or IPCount > 2
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| project UserPrincipalName, UniqueTokenIdentifier, AppCount, Apps, IPCount, IPs, Countries, RefreshCount, FirstSeen, LastSeen
| order by IPCount desc, AppCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Hunts for a single refresh token reused across 4+ apps or 2+ distinct IPs within 1 hour. Wide token reuse indicates possible theft or attacker automation.

properties.displayName: Hunt: Service Principal First-Seen Non-Interactive IP (30d baseline)
properties.query:
let LookbackWindow = 30d;
let RecentWindow   = 1d;
let Baseline =
    AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(LookbackWindow) .. ago(RecentWindow))
    | where ResultType == 0
    | summarize HistoricIPs = make_set(IPAddress) by ServicePrincipalName;
AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(RecentWindow)
| where ResultType == 0
| join kind=leftouter Baseline on ServicePrincipalName
| where isempty(HistoricIPs) or not(HistoricIPs has IPAddress)
| summarize Count=count(), Resources=make_set(ResourceDisplayName), Countries=make_set(Location), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by ServicePrincipalName, IPAddress
| order by Count desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Service principals reaching out from IPs not present in the prior 30-day baseline. Highlights compromised SP credentials replayed from attacker infrastructure or compromised CI/CD runners.

properties.displayName: Hunt: Long-Lived Token Still Refreshing After Password Change
properties.query:
let PasswordChanges =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where OperationName in ('User changed password', 'Reset user password', 'Change user password')
    | extend Target = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
    | summarize ChangeTime = max(TimeGenerated) by Target;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResultType == 0
| join kind=inner (PasswordChanges) on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.Target
| where TimeGenerated > ChangeTime
| extend TokenAge = TimeGenerated - todatetime(CreatedDateTime)
| where TokenAge > 14d
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, ChangeTime, AppDisplayName, IPAddress, Location, TokenAge, CorrelationId
| order by TokenAge desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Refresh tokens issued more than 14 days ago still actively refreshing after a user-initiated password change. Indicates pre-compromise tokens that remained valid post-rotation (Sentinel-recommended hunt for refresh token theft).

properties.displayName: Hunt: OAuth Consent Grant Followed by Immediate NI Token Issuance
properties.query:
let Consents =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | where OperationName has 'Consent to application'
    | extend Initiator = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | extend TargetApp = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
    | project ConsentTime = TimeGenerated, Initiator, TargetApp, CorrelationId;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| join kind=inner Consents on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.Initiator, $left.AppDisplayName == $right.TargetApp
| where TimeGenerated between (ConsentTime .. ConsentTime + 60m)
| summarize TokenCount = count(), IPs = make_set(IPAddress), FirstToken = min(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, ConsentTime
| order by ConsentTime desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Surfaces a new OAuth app consent followed within 60 minutes by non-interactive token issuance for that app. Detects consent-phishing chains (illicit consent grant T1528).

properties.displayName: Hunt: Cross-Tenant Non-Interactive Token Issuance (B2B Anomaly)
properties.query:
let HomeTenant = toscalar(AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | take 1 | project HomeTenantId);
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResultType == 0
| where isnotempty(HomeTenantId) and HomeTenantId != HomeTenant
| summarize SignIns = count(), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName), IPs = make_set(IPAddress), Locations = make_set(Location), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName, HomeTenantId
| order by SignIns desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Non-interactive tokens issued to users whose UPN belongs to an external/foreign tenant. Surfaces unexpected B2B activity and rogue cross-tenant access.

properties.displayName: Hunt: Tokens Persisting Past CA Policy Block (CAE Disabled)
properties.query:
let CABlocks =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | where ConditionalAccessStatus == 'failure' or ResultType in (53000, 53001, 53002, 53003)
    | summarize BlockTime = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType == 0
| join kind=inner CABlocks on UserPrincipalName
| where TimeGenerated > BlockTime
| extend MinutesAfterBlock = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, BlockTime)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, BlockTime, MinutesAfterBlock, AppDisplayName, IPAddress, Location, CorrelationId
| order by MinutesAfterBlock asc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Identifies non-interactive token use occurring AFTER a Conditional Access policy blocked the user interactively in the prior 24h - suggests Continuous Access Evaluation is not in force on that app or token reuse from before policy update.

properties.displayName: Hunt: NI Tokens Issued for Anomalous Resource APIs
properties.query:
let Baseline =
    AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d))
    | summarize UserCount = dcount(UserPrincipalName) by ResourceDisplayName
    | where UserCount > 5;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ResultType == 0
| join kind=leftanti Baseline on ResourceDisplayName
| summarize Count = count(), Users = dcount(UserPrincipalName), IPs = make_set(IPAddress), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName) by ResourceDisplayName, ResourceTenantId
| order by Count desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Detects non-interactive sign-ins requesting access to rare/anomalous Resource API IDs in your tenant. Useful for surfacing custom enterprise apps or rogue resource targets.

properties.displayName: Hunt: Impossible Token Velocity Across Countries
properties.query:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where ResultType == 0 and isnotempty(Location)
| sort by UserPrincipalName asc, TimeGenerated asc
| extend PrevLoc = prev(Location, 1), PrevTime = prev(TimeGenerated, 1), PrevUser = prev(UserPrincipalName, 1), PrevIP = prev(IPAddress, 1)
| where UserPrincipalName == PrevUser and Location != PrevLoc and (TimeGenerated - PrevTime) < 60m
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, FromCountry = PrevLoc, ToCountry = Location, FromIP = PrevIP, ToIP = IPAddress, Delta = TimeGenerated - PrevTime, AppDisplayName, CorrelationId
| order by Delta asc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Same user issued non-interactive tokens from 2+ distinct countries within 60 minutes - implausible physical travel suggests refresh-token replay (no interactive sign-in surface to detect it).

properties.displayName: Hunt: Non-Interactive Token Spike from Unmanaged Devices
properties.query:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType == 0
| extend DeviceDetailDyn = parse_json(tostring(DeviceDetail))
| extend DeviceId = tostring(DeviceDetailDyn.deviceId), TrustType = tostring(DeviceDetailDyn.trustType)
| where isempty(DeviceId)
| summarize TokenCount = count(), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName), IPs = make_set(IPAddress), Countries = make_set(Location) by UserPrincipalName
| where TokenCount > 50
| order by TokenCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Users with abnormally high non-interactive token volume from unmanaged/unregistered devices (no DeviceDetail.deviceId). Surfaces token use by unmanaged scripts or compromised personal devices.

properties.displayName: Token Theft - Refresh Token Replay from New Location
properties.description: Detects when the same user refreshes an OAuth token from a completely different IP address AND country within a 30-minute window. Indicator of refresh token theft / pass-the-cookie attacks. MITRE: T1528, T1539
properties.query:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| sort by UserPrincipalName asc, AppId asc, TimeGenerated asc
| extend PrevIP      = prev(IPAddress, 1)
| extend PrevCountry = prev(Location, 1)
| extend PrevTime    = prev(TimeGenerated, 1)
| extend PrevUser    = prev(UserPrincipalName, 1)
| extend PrevApp     = prev(AppId, 1)
| where UserPrincipalName == PrevUser
   and  AppId             == PrevApp
   and  IPAddress         != PrevIP
   and  Location          != PrevCountry
   and  (TimeGenerated - PrevTime) < 30m
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    PrevTokenTime    = PrevTime,
    UserPrincipalName,
    AppDisplayName,
    CurrentIP        = IPAddress,
    CurrentCountry   = Location,
    PreviousIP       = PrevIP,
    PreviousCountry  = PrevCountry,
    TimeBetweenTokens = (TimeGenerated - PrevTime),
    CorrelationId,
    UniqueTokenIdentifier
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Token Replay Detected - {{UserPrincipalName}} authenticated from new country after prior token from {{CurrentCountry}}
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: User {{UserPrincipalName}} refreshed a token from {{CurrentIP}} ({{CurrentCountry}}) within 30 min of a prior refresh from a different country. Possible refresh token theft.

properties.displayName: Non-Interactive Auth Followed by Privileged Audit Actions
properties.description: Detects when a user silently refreshes a token and then performs privileged Azure AD operations (role management, app/group/policy/device management) within 60 minutes. Indicative of session hijack or compromised account performing admin abuse. MITRE: T1078, T1098
properties.query:
let NonInteractiveUsers =
    AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
    | invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | summarize LastNISignIn = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress;
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
| where Category in (
    "RoleManagement", "ApplicationManagement", "GroupManagement",
    "Policy", "DeviceManagement", "UserManagement"
  )
| extend UPN = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| where isnotempty(UPN)
| join kind=inner NonInteractiveUsers on $left.UPN == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where (TimeGenerated - LastNISignIn) between (0m .. 60m)
| project
    AuditTime        = TimeGenerated,
    UserPrincipalName = UPN,
    OperationName,
    AuditResult      = Result,
    Category,
    TargetResources,
    LastNISignIn,
    IPAddress,
    TimeSinceNISignIn = (TimeGenerated - LastNISignIn)
| order by AuditTime desc

properties.displayName: Non-Interactive Sign-In from Threat Intelligence IP
properties.description: Detects non-interactive Azure AD sign-ins originating from IP addresses present in the ThreatIntelIndicators table (unified TI - replaces deprecated ThreatIntelligenceIndicator). Silent sign-ins from known-malicious IPs indicate an attacker has an active refresh token. MITRE: T1528, T1078
properties.query:
let MaliciousIPs =
    ThreatIntelIndicators
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where IsActive == true
    | where isempty(ValidUntil) or ValidUntil > now()
    | where Pattern has "ipv4-addr:value"
    | extend NetworkIP = extract(@"ipv4-addr:value = '([^']+)'", 1, Pattern)
    | where isnotempty(NetworkIP)
    | summarize ThreatTags = make_set(Tags) by NetworkIP;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| join kind=inner MaliciousIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.NetworkIP
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    UserPrincipalName,
    AppDisplayName,
    IPAddress,
    Location,
    ThreatTags,
    ConditionalAccessStatus,
    AuthenticationRequirement,
    CorrelationId,
    UniqueTokenIdentifier
| order by TimeGenerated desc

properties.displayName: Interactive to Non-Interactive Token Theft Pivot
properties.description: Detects when a user had a successful interactive sign-in (without MFA or CA not applied) and then the same session was used for non-interactive refreshes from a different IP and country within 2 hours. Classic token theft pattern. MITRE: T1528, T1539
properties.query:
// IP Exclusion Lists – add VPN egress IPs and CIDR ranges below
// Watchlist alternative: let KnownSafeIPs = (_GetWatchlist('VPNExcludedIPs') | project SearchKey);
let KnownSafeIPs = dynamic([
    // "203.0.113.50",       // Example VPN egress IP 1
    // "198.51.100.12",      // Example VPN egress IP 2
    // "20.x.x.x"            // Example Azure VPN Gateway public IP
]);
// Azure IP ranges reference: https://aka.ms/azureipranges
let KnownSafeNetworks = datatable(network:string) [
    // "10.0.0.0/8",         // RFC1918 – on-prem / private
    // "172.16.0.0/12",      // RFC1918 – on-prem / private
    // "192.168.0.0/16",     // RFC1918 – on-prem / private
    // "YOUR_VPN_CIDR/24",   // Corporate VPN egress subnet
    "0.0.0.0/32"             // Placeholder – keeps datatable valid when list is empty
];
let InteractiveSessions =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(3h)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | where AuthenticationRequirement == "singleFactorAuthentication"
       or   ConditionalAccessStatus   == "notApplied"
    | where not(IPAddress in (KnownSafeIPs))
    | evaluate ipv4_lookup(KnownSafeNetworks, IPAddress, network, return_unmatched = true)
    | where isempty(network)
    | project-away network
    | project
        UserPrincipalName,
        InteractiveTime    = TimeGenerated,
        InteractiveIP      = IPAddress,
        InteractiveCountry = Location,
        AppDisplayName,
        CorrelationId;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(3h)
| where ResultType == 0
| where not(IPAddress in (KnownSafeIPs))
| evaluate ipv4_lookup(KnownSafeNetworks, IPAddress, network, return_unmatched = true)
| where isempty(network)
| project-away network
| join kind=inner InteractiveSessions on UserPrincipalName
| where IPAddress != InteractiveIP
   and  Location  != InteractiveCountry
   and  (TimeGenerated - InteractiveTime) between (1m .. 2h)
| project
    NISignInTime       = TimeGenerated,
    InteractiveTime,
    UserPrincipalName,
    AppDisplayName,
    NIIPAddress        = IPAddress,
    NICountry          = Location,
    InteractiveIP,
    InteractiveCountry,
    CorrelationId,
    UniqueTokenIdentifier,
    TimeSinceInteractive = (TimeGenerated - InteractiveTime)
| order by UserPrincipalName asc, InteractiveTime asc

properties.displayName: Device Code Flow Authentication Abuse
properties.description: Detects non-interactive sign-ins using device code flow. This protocol is abused in phishing attacks where a user is tricked into entering a code; the attacker redeems it for a long-lived refresh token. MITRE: T1528, T1566
properties.query:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where AuthenticationProtocol == "deviceCode"
   or   ClientAppUsed has_any ("device code", "device_code", "Device Code")
| summarize
    Count     = count(),
    IPs       = make_set(IPAddress),
    Countries = make_set(Location),
    Apps      = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by Count desc

properties.displayName: ROPC Authentication Detected - Credential Pass-Through Bypass
properties.description: Detects successful Resource Owner Password Credential (ROPC) grant flow. ROPC passes credentials directly to Entra ID bypassing MFA and Conditional Access completely. Failures are covered by rule 24 (ROPC-CredentialStuffing). Edit LegitRopcApps / LegitRopcUsers to suppress sanctioned ROPC clients. MITRE: T1110, T1078, T1550
properties.query:
let LegitRopcApps = dynamic(["Microsoft Authentication Broker","Microsoft Intune Company Portal","Azure AD Connect","Microsoft Office","Microsoft Office Authentication Broker"]);
let LegitRopcUsers = dynamic([]);
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where AuthenticationProtocol =~ "ropc"
| where ResultType == 0
| where AppDisplayName !in~ (LegitRopcApps)
| where tolower(UserPrincipalName) !in~ (LegitRopcUsers)
| summarize
    Count     = count(),
    IPs       = make_set(IPAddress),
    Countries = make_set(Location),
    Apps      = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by Count desc

properties.displayName: Non-Interactive Sign-In via TOR or Anonymous Proxy
properties.description: Detects non-interactive Azure AD sign-ins from IP addresses tagged as TOR exit nodes, anonymous proxies, or VPN anonymizers in ThreatIntelIndicators (unified TI - replaces deprecated ThreatIntelligenceIndicator). Attackers use anonymization to hide their location when replaying stolen refresh tokens. MITRE: T1090, T1090.003
properties.query:
let TorExitIPs =
    ThreatIntelIndicators
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where IsActive == true
    | where isempty(ValidUntil) or ValidUntil > now()
    | where Tags has_any ("tor", "proxy", "anonymizer", "vpn", "anonymity")
    | where Pattern has "ipv4-addr:value"
    | extend NetworkIP = extract(@"ipv4-addr:value = '([^']+)'", 1, Pattern)
    | where isnotempty(NetworkIP)
    | summarize AnonymizationType = make_set(Tags) by NetworkIP;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| join kind=inner TorExitIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.NetworkIP
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    UserPrincipalName,
    AppDisplayName,
    IPAddress,
    Location,
    AnonymizationType,
    ConditionalAccessStatus,
    AuthenticationRequirement,
    CorrelationId,
    UniqueTokenIdentifier
| order by TimeGenerated desc

properties.displayName: Brute Force Success - Credential Stuffing Succeeded
properties.description: Detects the brute force success pattern: account experiences multiple non-interactive failures with brute-force error codes followed by a successful sign-in — attacker eventually guessed or stuffed the correct credentials. MITRE: T1110, T1110.004
properties.query:
let BruteForceErrors = dynamic(["50126","50055","50056","50064","50053","50034","50057","50128"]);
let Failures =
    AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
    | invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(3h)
    | extend ErrorCode = tostring(ResultType)
    | where ErrorCode in (BruteForceErrors)
    | summarize
        FailCount = count(),
        LastFail  = max(TimeGenerated),
        FailIPs   = make_set(IPAddress),
        Countries = make_set(Location)
      by UserPrincipalName;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(3h)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize
    FirstSuccess = min(TimeGenerated),
    SuccessIP    = tostring(make_set(IPAddress)[0])
  by UserPrincipalName
| join kind=inner Failures on UserPrincipalName
| where FailCount > 15
   and  FirstSuccess > LastFail
| project
    UserPrincipalName,
    FailCount,
    LastFail,
    FirstSuccess,
    TimeBetweenFailAndSuccess = (FirstSuccess - LastFail),
    FailIPs,
    SuccessIP,
    Countries
| order by FailCount desc

properties.displayName: MFA Fatigue Attack - Push Bombing Followed by Silent Token Abuse
properties.description: Detects MFA fatigue (push bombing) attack pattern: user receives many failed MFA prompts, eventually approves, then attacker heavily uses non-interactive tokens. Used by LAPSUS$ and Scattered Spider. MITRE: T1621
properties.query:
let MFAFatigue =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(4h)
    | where ResultType in (50074, 500121, 50076)
    | summarize
        MFAAttempts  = count(),
        FirstAttempt = min(TimeGenerated)
      by UserPrincipalName;
let MFASuccess =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(4h)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | where AuthenticationRequirement == "multiFactorAuthentication"
    | summarize MFASuccessTime = min(TimeGenerated), SuccessIP = tostring(make_set(IPAddress)[0])
      by UserPrincipalName;
MFAFatigue
| where MFAAttempts >= 8
| join kind=inner MFASuccess on UserPrincipalName
| where MFASuccessTime > FirstAttempt
| join kind=inner (
    AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
    | invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(4h)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | summarize NI_Count = count(), NI_Countries = make_set(Location), NI_IPs = make_set(IPAddress)
      by UserPrincipalName
  ) on UserPrincipalName
| where NI_Count > 25
| project
    UserPrincipalName,
    MFAAttempts,
    FirstMFAPrompt   = FirstAttempt,
    MFASuccessTime,
    SuccessIP,
    NI_Count,
    NI_Countries
| order by MFAAttempts desc

properties.displayName: Stale Token Used After Password Change or Auth Method Update
properties.description: Detects non-interactive token refreshes continuing AFTER a user's password or authentication methods were changed/reset. An attacker with a pre-existing refresh token can maintain access even after credential reset. MITRE: T1528, T1078
properties.query:
let PasswordChanges =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | where OperationName has_any (
        "Reset password",
        "Change password",
        "User changed password",
        "Admin updated user authentication method",
        "Update Authentication Method",
        "Delete Authentication Method"
      )
    | extend UPN = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
    | where isnotempty(UPN)
    | summarize ChangeTime = max(TimeGenerated) by UPN;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType == 0
| join kind=inner PasswordChanges on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.UPN
| where TimeGenerated > ChangeTime
| summarize
    TokensAfterChange = count(),
    IPs               = make_set(IPAddress),
    Countries         = make_set(Location),
    Apps              = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    LastSeen          = max(TimeGenerated),
    FirstTokenAfter   = min(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName, ChangeTime
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by TokensAfterChange desc

properties.displayName: Account Takeover - Email Forwarding Rule After Silent Auth
properties.description: Detects Business Email Compromise (BEC) indicator: inbox forwarding/redirect rule created within 2 hours of a non-interactive sign-in. Attackers set up email forwarding immediately after obtaining access via token theft. MITRE: T1114, T1114.003
properties.query:
let SilentAuthUsers =
    AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
    | invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(3h)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | summarize LastNI = max(TimeGenerated), NI_IPs = make_set(IPAddress)
      by UserPrincipalName;
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(3h)
| where Operation in (
    "New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "UpdateInboxRules", "Set-Mailbox"
  )
| where Parameters has_any (
    "ForwardTo", "RedirectTo", "ForwardAsAttachmentTo",
    "DeleteMessage", "MarkAsRead"
  )
| extend UPN = tolower(UserId)
| join kind=inner SilentAuthUsers on $left.UPN == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where TimeGenerated > LastNI
   and  (TimeGenerated - LastNI) < 2h
| project
    RuleCreationTime  = TimeGenerated,
    UserPrincipalName = UPN,
    Operation,
    Parameters,
    NI_IPs,
    LastNISignIn      = LastNI,
    TimeSinceNISignIn = (TimeGenerated - LastNI),
    ClientIP
| order by RuleCreationTime desc

properties.displayName: PIM Role Activation Followed by Non-Interactive Token Use
properties.description: Detects when a PIM role is activated and the user immediately uses a non-interactive token within 30 minutes. Indicates possible PIM abuse to temporarily elevate privileges and perform admin operations stealthily. MITRE: T1078, T1098, T1134
properties.query:
let PIMActivations =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
    | where OperationName has "Add member to role completed (PIM activation)"
    | extend UPN = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | where isnotempty(UPN)
    | project
        ActivationTime = TimeGenerated,
        UPN,
        RoleName       = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName);
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
| where ResultType == 0
| join kind=inner PIMActivations on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.UPN
| where TimeGenerated > ActivationTime
   and  (TimeGenerated - ActivationTime) < 30m
| project
    NISignInTime       = TimeGenerated,
    ActivationTime,
    UserPrincipalName,
    RoleName,
    AppDisplayName,
    IPAddress,
    Location,
    TimeSincePIMActivation = (TimeGenerated - ActivationTime)
| order by NISignInTime desc

properties.displayName: OAuth App Consent Followed by Immediate Silent Authentication
properties.description: Detects illicit OAuth consent grant attack: user grants consent to an app in Audit Logs, same app immediately begins non-interactive sign-ins within 24 hours. Signature of phishing-induced app consent granting persistent mailbox/file access. MITRE: T1528, T1566
properties.query:
let RecentConsents =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | where OperationName has_any (
        "Consent to application",
        "Add app role assignment",
        "Add delegated permission grant"
      )
    | extend ActorUPN    = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | extend AppId       = tostring(TargetResources[0].id)
    | extend AppName     = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
    | where isnotempty(ActorUPN)
    | project ConsentTime=TimeGenerated, ActorUPN, AppId, AppName, OperationName;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType == 0
| join kind=inner RecentConsents
    on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.ActorUPN, $left.AppId == $right.AppId
| where TimeGenerated > ConsentTime
   and  (TimeGenerated - ConsentTime) < 24h
| summarize
    NI_Count     = count(),
    IPs          = make_set(IPAddress),
    Countries    = make_set(Location),
    FirstUse     = min(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName, AppName, AppId, ConsentTime, OperationName
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by ConsentTime desc

properties.displayName: Impossible Travel - Non-Interactive Sign-Ins from Multiple Countries
properties.description: Detects users successfully authenticating via non-interactive sign-ins from 3 or more distinct countries within 1 hour. 3+ countries in 1 hour is physically impossible and strongly indicates refresh token theft replayed from multiple attacker locations. MITRE: T1078
properties.query:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize
    Countries    = make_set(Location),
    CountryCount = dcount(Location),
    IPs          = make_set(IPAddress),
    Apps         = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    FirstSeen    = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen     = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName
| where CountryCount >= 4
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by CountryCount desc

properties.displayName: Legacy Authentication Bypassing MFA and Conditional Access
properties.description: Detects successful non-interactive sign-ins using legacy authentication protocols (EAS, IMAP, POP3, SMTP, MAPI). These protocols cannot participate in MFA challenges or Conditional Access, completely bypassing security controls. MITRE: T1078, T1550
properties.query:
let LegacyProtocols = dynamic([
    "Exchange ActiveSync", "IMAP4", "MAPI Over HTTP",
    "POP3", "SMTP", "Authenticated SMTP", "AutoDiscover",
    "Exchange Online PowerShell", "Exchange Web Services",
    "Other clients", "Other clients; IMAP", "Other clients; POP"
]);
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ClientAppUsed in (LegacyProtocols)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize
    SignInCount = count(),
    IPs         = make_set(IPAddress),
    Countries   = make_set(Location),
    Protocols   = make_set(ClientAppUsed),
    FirstSeen   = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen    = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName
| where SignInCount > 8
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by SignInCount desc

properties.displayName: Password Spray Attack via Non-Interactive Sign-Ins
properties.description: Detects horizontal password spray attacks where a single IP attempts authentication against many user accounts. Attacker spreads attempts to stay below per-account lockout thresholds. Non-interactive spray skips MFA prompts making it stealthy. MITRE: T1110.003
properties.query:
let SprayErrors = dynamic(["50126", "50034", "50053"]);
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| extend ErrorCode = tostring(ResultType)
| where ErrorCode in (SprayErrors)
| summarize
    TargetCount = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
    Targets     = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 30),
    FailCount   = count(),
    ErrorCodes  = make_set(ErrorCode),
    UserAgents  = make_set(UserAgent),
    FirstSeen   = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen    = max(TimeGenerated)
  by IPAddress, Location
| where TargetCount > 25
| order by TargetCount desc

properties.displayName: New or Rogue OAuth Application First Seen in Tenant
properties.description: Detects OAuth applications appearing for the first time in past 7 days with no prior activity in preceding 30 days. New apps suddenly generating non-interactive sign-ins can indicate illicit consent, rogue app registration, or supply chain compromise. MITRE: T1528, T1199
properties.query:
let KnownApps =
    AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
    | invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(7d))
    | summarize by AppId;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResultType == 0
| join kind=leftanti KnownApps on AppId
| summarize
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    UserCount = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
    Users     = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 10),
    IPs       = make_set(IPAddress),
    Countries = make_set(Location)
  by AppDisplayName, AppId
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by FirstSeen desc

properties.displayName: Service Principal Authenticating from Anomalous IP Spread
properties.description: Detects service principals (workload identities) authenticating from 4+ distinct IPs in 24 hours. Legitimate service principals have stable IP footprints. Wide IP spread indicates compromised service principal credentials being used from attacker infrastructure. MITRE: T1078.004
properties.query:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where isnotempty(ServicePrincipalId)
   and  ResultType == 0
| summarize
    SignInCount = count(),
    UniqueIPs   = dcount(IPAddress),
    IPs         = make_set(IPAddress),
    Countries   = make_set(Location),
    FirstSeen   = min(TimeGenerated)
  by AppDisplayName, ServicePrincipalId
| where UniqueIPs > 8
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by UniqueIPs desc

properties.displayName: Non-Interactive Sign-In from High-Risk Country
properties.description: Detects successful non-interactive sign-ins from countries designated as high-risk (sanctioned nations, high APT origination). Silent authentication from these regions may indicate stolen token use from attacker infrastructure. Customize the country list as needed. MITRE: T1078
properties.query:
let HighRiskCountries = dynamic(["KP","IR","RU","CN","BY","CU","SY","VE","MM"]);
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| where Location in (HighRiskCountries)
| summarize
    Count     = count(),
    Apps      = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    IPs       = make_set(IPAddress),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName, Location
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by Count desc

properties.displayName: Non-Interactive Brute Force - Single User Targeted by Multiple IPs
properties.description: Detects targeted brute force/credential stuffing against a single user account via non-interactive sign-ins using multiple source IPs. Attacker distributes attempts across IPs to avoid rate limiting and account lockout. MITRE: T1110, T1110.001, T1110.004
properties.query:
let BruteForceErrors = dynamic(["50126","50055","50056","50064","50053","50034","50057","50128"]);
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| extend ErrorCode = tostring(ResultType)
| where ErrorCode in (BruteForceErrors)
| summarize
    FailCount   = count(),
    UniqueIPs   = dcount(IPAddress),
    IPs         = make_set(IPAddress, 20),
    Countries   = make_set(Location),
    ErrorCodes  = make_set(ErrorCode),
    FirstSeen   = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen    = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName
| where FailCount > 50
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by FailCount desc

properties.displayName: Non-Interactive Auth Followed by Bulk Data Download
properties.description: Detects when a user silently refreshes an OAuth token and then performs bulk file downloads or access operations in SharePoint/OneDrive within 2 hours. Correlates non-interactive token use with data exfiltration indicators. MITRE: T1048, T1213
properties.query:
let SilentAuthUsers =
    AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
    | invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | summarize SilentSignIns = count(), LastNI = max(TimeGenerated)
      by UserPrincipalName;
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
| where Operation in (
    "FileDownloaded", "FileSyncDownloadedFull",
    "SearchQueryPerformed", "FileAccessed"
  )
| summarize
    OpCount    = count(),
    FileCount  = dcount(SourceFileName),
    Operations = make_set(Operation),
    ClientIP   = tostring(make_set(ClientIP)[0])
  by UserId
| where OpCount > 150
| join kind=inner SilentAuthUsers on $left.UserId == $right.UserPrincipalName
| project
    UserPrincipalName = UserId,
    OperationCount    = OpCount,
    UniqueFiles       = FileCount,
    Operations,
    SilentSignIns,
    ClientIP
| order by OperationCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Data Exfiltration Risk - {{UserPrincipalName}} downloaded {{UniqueFiles}} files after silent auth
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: User {{UserPrincipalName}} performed {{OperationCount}} file operations ({{UniqueFiles}} unique files) in SharePoint/OneDrive after a silent auth. Possible data exfiltration.

properties.displayName: Non-Interactive Sign-Ins by Identity Protection Risky Users
properties.description: Detects users flagged High or Medium risk by Azure AD Identity Protection who continue performing non-interactive token refreshes. Active NI token use for a confirmed-compromised user means the attacker retained persistent access that bypasses risk-based CA controls. MITRE: T1078, T1528, T1550
properties.query:
let HighRiskUsers =
    AADRiskyUsers
    | where RiskState in ("atRisk", "confirmedCompromised")
    | where RiskLevel in ("high", "medium")
    | project UserPrincipalName, RiskLevel, RiskState, RiskDetail;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize
    SilentCount  = count(),
    Countries    = make_set(Location),
    IPs          = make_set(IPAddress),
    Apps         = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    LastActivity = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName
| join kind=inner HighRiskUsers on UserPrincipalName
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| project
    UserPrincipalName,
    RiskLevel,
    RiskState,
    RiskDetail,
    SilentCount,
    Countries,
    IPAddress,
    Apps,
    LastActivity
| order by SilentCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Risky User Silent Auth - {{UserPrincipalName}} ({{RiskLevel}} risk) has active non-interactive tokens
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: User {{UserPrincipalName}} is flagged as {{RiskLevel}} risk but performed {{SilentCount}} non-interactive sign-ins. Identity Protection risk has not blocked active silent token refresh.

properties.displayName: High-Frequency Token Refresh - Possible Session Hijack or Automated Abuse
properties.description: Detects users or IPs generating more than 50 successful non-interactive token refreshes within 1 hour. Legitimate clients refresh tokens at reasonable intervals. Extremely high rates indicate automated token replay, session hijack, or malware maintaining persistence. MITRE: T1528, T1078
properties.query:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize
    RefreshCount = count(),
    Apps         = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    Countries    = make_set(Location)
  by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
| where RefreshCount > 150
| order by RefreshCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: User {{UserPrincipalName}} performed {{RefreshCount}} non-interactive token refreshes in 1 hour from {{IPAddress}}. Rate suggests automated token replay or session hijack.

properties.displayName: ROPC Credential Stuffing - Failed Password Grant Spray
properties.description: Credential-stuffing pattern over the ROPC grant: >=15 password-grant failures from a single IP against >=5 distinct UPNs within 1 hour. ROPC is favoured by stuffing tools as it bypasses MFA. MITRE: T1110.003, T1078
properties.query:
let LegitRopcApps = dynamic(["Microsoft Authentication Broker","Microsoft Intune Company Portal","Azure AD Connect","Microsoft Office","Microsoft Office Authentication Broker"]);
let SprayErrors = dynamic(["50126","50053","50056","50055","50064"]);
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where AuthenticationProtocol =~ "ropc"
| where ResultType in (SprayErrors)
| where AppDisplayName !in~ (LegitRopcApps)
| summarize
    FailCount = count(),
    Users     = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
    UserList  = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 50),
    Apps      = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    Errors    = make_set(ResultType),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated)
  by IPAddress, Location
| where FailCount >= 15 and Users >= 5
| order by FailCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: ROPC Credential Stuffing from {{IPAddress}} ({{Users}} users, {{FailCount}} failures)
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Source IP {{IPAddress}} ({{Location}}) attempted {{FailCount}} ROPC password grants against {{Users}} distinct user accounts. ROPC bypasses MFA.

properties.displayName: ROPC Authentication Against Privileged User
properties.description: Successful ROPC sign-in by an account holding a privileged Entra ID role (from IdentityInfo.AssignedRoles in the last 14 days). Privileged users should never use ROPC - treat as suspected account takeover. MITRE: T1078.004, T1098
properties.query:
let LegitRopcApps = dynamic(["Microsoft Authentication Broker","Microsoft Intune Company Portal","Azure AD Connect","Microsoft Office","Microsoft Office Authentication Broker"]);
let PrivUsers =
    IdentityInfo
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where isnotempty(AssignedRoles)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AssignedRoles) by AccountUPN
    | extend Upn = tolower(AccountUPN)
    | project Upn, AssignedRoles;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where AuthenticationProtocol =~ "ropc"
| where ResultType == 0
| where AppDisplayName !in~ (LegitRopcApps)
| extend Upn = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner PrivUsers on Upn
| summarize
    Count     = count(),
    IPs       = make_set(IPAddress),
    Countries = make_set(Location),
    Apps      = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    Roles     = any(AssignedRoles),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by Count desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Privileged user {{UserPrincipalName}} authenticated via ROPC ({{Count}} sign-ins from {{Countries}}). Treat as suspected account takeover.

properties.displayName: ROPC Sign-In from New Country or ASN for User
properties.description: Successful ROPC sign-in whose (Country, ASN) pair has not been observed for that user in the prior 30 days. ROPC bypasses MFA - first-seen-location is one of the few remaining signals that a stolen credential is being replayed. MITRE: T1078, T1550
properties.query:
let LegitRopcApps = dynamic(["Microsoft Authentication Broker","Microsoft Intune Company Portal","Azure AD Connect","Microsoft Office","Microsoft Office Authentication Broker"]);
let Lookback = 30d;
let Window   = 1h;
let Baseline =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (SigninLogs
            | where TimeGenerated between (ago(Lookback) .. ago(Window))),
        (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
            | where TimeGenerated between (ago(Lookback) .. ago(Window)))
    | where ResultType == 0
    | extend Upn = tolower(UserPrincipalName),
             Pair = strcat(Location, "|", tostring(AutonomousSystemNumber))
    | summarize KnownPairs = make_set(Pair) by Upn;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
| where AuthenticationProtocol =~ "ropc"
| where ResultType == 0
| where AppDisplayName !in~ (LegitRopcApps)
| extend Upn = tolower(UserPrincipalName),
         Pair = strcat(Location, "|", tostring(AutonomousSystemNumber))
| join kind=leftouter Baseline on Upn
| where isnull(KnownPairs) or not(set_has_element(KnownPairs, Pair))
| summarize
    Count     = count(),
    IPs       = make_set(IPAddress),
    Countries = make_set(Location),
    ASNs      = make_set(AutonomousSystemNumber),
    Apps      = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by Count desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{UserPrincipalName}} authenticated via ROPC from a country/ASN combination ({{Countries}}, ASN {{ASNs}}) not seen in 30 days.

properties.displayName: ROPC Authentication Against Dormant Account
properties.description: Successful ROPC sign-in on an account with no successful interactive or non-interactive sign-in in the prior 30 days. Strong indicator of breach-replay or credential-stuffing success. MITRE: T1078, T1110
properties.query:
let LegitRopcApps = dynamic(["Microsoft Authentication Broker","Microsoft Intune Company Portal","Azure AD Connect","Microsoft Office","Microsoft Office Authentication Broker"]);
let LegitRopcUsers = dynamic([]);
let Active =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (SigninLogs
            | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(1h))),
        (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
            | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(1h)))
    | where ResultType == 0
    | distinct Upn = tolower(UserPrincipalName);
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where AuthenticationProtocol =~ "ropc"
| where ResultType == 0
| where AppDisplayName !in~ (LegitRopcApps)
| extend Upn = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| where Upn !in (LegitRopcUsers)
| where Upn !in (Active)
| summarize
    Count     = count(),
    IPs       = make_set(IPAddress),
    Countries = make_set(Location),
    Apps      = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by Count desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Dormant account {{UserPrincipalName}} (no successful sign-in in 30 days) authenticated via ROPC from {{Countries}}.

properties.displayName: ROPC Impossible Travel - Multiple Countries via Password Grant
properties.description: Same user authenticated via ROPC from >=2 countries within 1 hour. ROPC requires cleartext password on every call - parallel multi-country use implies stolen credentials being replayed from different attacker locations. MITRE: T1078, T1550
properties.query:
let LegitRopcApps = dynamic(["Microsoft Authentication Broker","Microsoft Intune Company Portal","Azure AD Connect","Microsoft Office","Microsoft Office Authentication Broker"]);
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_AADNI()
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where AuthenticationProtocol =~ "ropc"
| where ResultType == 0
| where AppDisplayName !in~ (LegitRopcApps)
| where isnotempty(Location)
| summarize
    Count        = count(),
    Countries    = make_set(Location),
    CountryCount = dcount(Location),
    IPs          = make_set(IPAddress),
    Apps         = make_set(AppDisplayName),
    FirstSeen    = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen     = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName
| where CountryCount >= 2
| extend IPAddress = tostring(IPs[0])
| order by CountryCount desc, Count desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{UserPrincipalName}} authenticated via ROPC from {{CountryCount}} countries ({{Countries}}) within 1 hour. Strong account-takeover signal.
